description: Canonical parameter dictionary for analog-to-digital converters, merging five architectural sub-shapes that share one measurement envelope into a single family: (1) 'sar' successive-approximation converters (DC-accuracy + dynamic, moderate speed); (2) 'delta_sigma' oversampling converters (the 2-D input-referred noise table over DATA_RATE x GAIN is the heart of the part - effective_resolution / noise_free_resolution derive from it, and the on-chip digital_filter/rejection keys apply); (3) 'pipelined' converters (dynamic performance swept vs input frequency F_IN dominates); (4) 'rf_sampling' GSPS converters (noise_spectral_density, interleaving_spur, worst_spur, full-power input_bandwidth, aperture_jitter); and (5) 'audio' converters (dynamic_range A-weighted vs unweighted via the WEIGHTING axis, THD+N, and the digital_filter passband/stopband/group_delay keys). component.sub_type selects the architecture; a part populates only the groups its architecture uses (delta_sigma -> the noise table; pipelined/rf_sampling -> dynamic-vs-F_IN; audio -> digital_filter + dynamic_range), while resolution, sample_rate, the linearity/accuracy keys, analog_input, reference, timing, power, and thermal keys are common. Resolution and every bit-based figure (effective_number_of_bits/ENOB from SINAD, effective_resolution and noise_free_resolution from DC noise) use the 'bits' unit and permit fractional values; LSB is NOT a legal unit - INL/DNL normalize to ppm (altUnits % or V), offset to V, gain error to %, and the printed LSB figure is preserved in conditionsVerbatim. Every ratio/distortion figure in dB rides its reference (dBFS vs dBc, or a per-Hz dBFS/Hz for noise_spectral_density) in conditionsVerbatim and MUST NOT be merged across references. Full-scale input amplitudes printed as Vrms or Vpp stay in unit V with the measurement's statistic (rms / peak_to_peak) carrying the distinction, never a Vrms/Vpp unit. Condition axes for this family: F_IN (input signal frequency), F_S (sample rate as a condition), DATA_RATE (output data rate / ODR), GAIN (PGA gain), A_IN (input amplitude in dBFS or Vrms), V_REF (reference voltage), WEIGHTING (A-weighted / unweighted, note-only), OSR (oversampling ratio, note-only), MODE (power/speed mode, note-only), BUFFER (input buffer on/off, note-only), RANGE (input-range setting, note-only), PHASE (sample/hold, note-only), BW_POINT (-3dB / -0.1dB, note-only), V_SUPPLY (which rail, note-only), REFERENCE (the dB reference convention for a dynamic-performance figure - values dBFS / dBc / dBFS-per-Hz, note-only - carried alongside conditionsVerbatim on SNR/SINAD/THD/HDx/SFDR/worst_spur/NSD so a dBc suppression is never compared against a dBFS level), BW_LOW, BW_HIGH, F, T_A, PACKAGE, DIRECTION. Pin functions: AINP/AINN differential inputs, AIN0.. / AINCOM / COM multiplexed single-ended inputs; VREF / REFP / REFN / REFIO reference; AVDD / DVDD / OVDD / AGND / DGND supplies; SPI control SCLK/SDI/SDO/CS/CONVST/CNV/DRDY/BUSY; I2C control SCL/SDA/ADDR/ALERT; high-speed serdes CLKP/CLKN/SYSREF/SYNC plus JESD204 lanes; audio serial BCK/LRCK/MCLK/SDOUT. Base-SI throughout; aliases normalize the printed datasheet symbols across vendors (TI, Analog Devices, Cirrus Logic, AKM, ESS, Microchip, onsemi).

parameters.name: Resolution
parameters.hint: Number of output bits. Fractional not applicable here (this is the nominal word length); the achieved-bit figures are effective_number_of_bits / effective_resolution / noise_free_resolution.

parameters.name: No missing codes
parameters.hint: Guaranteed resolution over which no output code is skipped (e.g. '16 bits, no missing codes'). Bits.

parameters.name: Sample rate
parameters.hint: Aggregate sampling / throughput rate in Hz (1 MSPS = 1e6, 1 GSPS = 1e9). Array over MODE when a part offers several speed/power modes. Distinct from output_data_rate on oversampling parts.

parameters.name: Output data rate
parameters.hint: Rate at which converted words are delivered (delta-sigma). On an oversampling part this differs from sample_rate by the OSR. Array over MODE (the ODR setting).

parameters.name: Integral nonlinearity
parameters.hint: Deviation of the transfer function from the ideal line, normalized to ppm of full-scale (altUnits % or V). NEVER use LSB - the printed LSB figure goes in conditionsVerbatim. Array over GAIN on PGA parts.

parameters.name: Differential nonlinearity
parameters.hint: Deviation of each code width from 1 LSB, normalized to ppm of full-scale (altUnits % or V). NEVER use LSB as a unit - keep the printed LSB value in conditionsVerbatim. Array over GAIN.

parameters.name: Offset error
parameters.hint: Bipolar/zero-scale offset. Canonical unit V; altUnits ppm or % of full-scale. Array over GAIN on PGA parts.

parameters.name: Offset drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of offset. Canonical V/degC; altUnits ppm/degC of full-scale. Array over GAIN.

parameters.name: Gain error
parameters.hint: Full-scale / gain error, canonical % of full-scale (altUnits ppm). NEVER use LSB. Array over GAIN.

parameters.name: Gain drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of gain, ppm/degC of full-scale. Array over GAIN.

parameters.name: Total unadjusted error
parameters.hint: Combined worst-case error (offset + gain + linearity) without calibration, % of full-scale.

parameters.name: Offset error matching
parameters.hint: Channel-to-channel offset matching on a multi-channel part, in V (altUnits not enumerated - keep printed ppm in conditionsVerbatim).

parameters.name: Gain error matching
parameters.hint: Channel-to-channel gain matching on a multi-channel part, % of full-scale.

parameters.name: Long-term gain drift
parameters.hint: Long-term stability (e.g. 1000-hour drift), ppm of full-scale; keep the stated hour count in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Input-referred noise (RMS)
parameters.hint: The delta-sigma heart: RMS input-referred noise, statistic rms. This is a 2-D table swept over DATA_RATE and GAIN - emit one measurement per (DATA_RATE, GAIN) cell (conditionAxis names the primary axis DATA_RATE; carry GAIN as a second condition). Canonical V, altUnits ppm of full-scale.

parameters.name: Input-referred noise (peak-to-peak)
parameters.hint: Peak-to-peak input-referred noise, statistic peak_to_peak. Swept over DATA_RATE (and GAIN as a second condition). V.

parameters.name: Input voltage noise density
parameters.hint: Input-referred voltage noise spectral density (en) in V/sqrtHz. Array over GAIN. Distinct from noise_spectral_density (a dBFS/Hz figure).

parameters.name: Effective resolution (RMS)
parameters.hint: DC noise-based resolution = log2(full-scale / RMS input-referred noise). Bits, fractional. Swept over DATA_RATE (and GAIN). Distinct from effective_number_of_bits (an AC/SINAD figure).

parameters.name: Noise-free resolution
parameters.hint: Peak-to-peak noise-based resolution = log2(full-scale / peak-to-peak noise), ~2.7 bits below effective_resolution. Bits, fractional. Swept over DATA_RATE (and GAIN).

parameters.name: Effective number of bits
parameters.hint: Dynamic ENOB = (SINAD - 1.76)/6.02, derived from SINAD. Bits, fractional. Swept over input frequency F_IN. Keep the SINAD/A_IN conditions with the measurement.

parameters.name: Dynamic range
parameters.hint: Ratio of full-scale to the noise floor with no signal (audio). Array over WEIGHTING (A-weighted vs unweighted) - do not merge the two. dB (dBFS reference in conditionsVerbatim).

parameters.name: Transition noise
parameters.hint: RMS code transition (input-referred DC) noise, V (altUnits ppm of FSR); keep any printed LSB figure in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Signal-to-noise ratio
parameters.hint: SNR (noise only, harmonics excluded). Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure.

parameters.name: Signal-to-noise-and-distortion
parameters.hint: SINAD (noise + harmonics). dB, reference in conditionsVerbatim. ENOB derives from this. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Total harmonic distortion
parameters.hint: THD, canonical dB (altUnits % for audio parts). Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure.

parameters.name: THD+N
parameters.hint: THD+N (audio), canonical dB (altUnits %). Swept over input amplitude A_IN (dBFS). Reference in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Spurious-free dynamic range
parameters.hint: SFDR - full-scale to the largest spur. dB. Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Second-harmonic distortion
parameters.hint: Second harmonic. dB. Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Third-harmonic distortion
parameters.hint: Third harmonic. dB. Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Worst spurious
parameters.hint: Worst non-harmonic spur (rf_sampling). dB. Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Intermodulation distortion
parameters.hint: Two-tone third-order intermodulation. dB; keep the two tone frequencies in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Noise spectral density
parameters.hint: Full-scale-referred noise density in dBFS/Hz (rf_sampling). Unit dB. Store the datasheet's printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and in the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression (SFDR/HDx) is a positive magnitude; a dBFS distortion level (THD on some parts) is negative; NSD is a negative dBFS/Hz level. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Interleaving spur
parameters.hint: Time-interleave image/offset spur (rf_sampling), typically at fS/2 +/- fIN. dB, reference in conditionsVerbatim. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Crosstalk
parameters.hint: Channel-to-channel isolation on a multi-channel part. dB. Swept over F_IN.

parameters.name: Interchannel gain mismatch
parameters.hint: Gain match between channels expressed in dB (rf_sampling/audio).

parameters.name: Interchannel phase deviation
parameters.hint: Phase match between channels, in degrees.

parameters.name: Full-scale input range
parameters.hint: Full-scale input range in V. A Vpp or Vrms full-scale figure stays in V with the measurement's statistic (peak_to_peak / rms) carrying the distinction - never a Vrms/Vpp unit. Array over RANGE (the input-range setting).

parameters.name: Input impedance
parameters.hint: DC/AC input impedance in ohm. On delta-sigma parts it varies with GAIN (switched-cap load) - array over GAIN.

parameters.name: Input impedance drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of input impedance, ppm/degC.

parameters.name: Input capacitance
parameters.hint: Analog input capacitance, F. Array over PHASE (sample vs hold) when the datasheet distinguishes them.

parameters.name: Input bias current
parameters.hint: Input bias / leakage current, A. Array over GAIN. Keep the sign convention in conditionsVerbatim if the datasheet is signed.

parameters.name: Common-mode input range
parameters.hint: Allowable input common-mode voltage range, V.

parameters.name: Input bandwidth
parameters.hint: Analog / full-power input bandwidth, Hz. Array over BW_POINT (-3dB vs -0.1dB).

parameters.name: Input overvoltage tolerance
parameters.hint: Input overvoltage tolerance / protection threshold, V (typically an absolute_max).

parameters.name: Sampling capacitance
parameters.hint: Switched sampling capacitor value, F - sets the input driver settling requirement.

parameters.name: Anti-aliasing filter response
parameters.hint: On-chip anti-aliasing filter corner (-3dB), Hz.

parameters.name: Excitation current
parameters.hint: Programmable excitation (IDAC) current for ratiometric RTD/bridge sensing, A.

parameters.name: External reference voltage range
parameters.hint: Allowable external reference voltage range, V. Distinct from internal_reference_voltage.

parameters.name: Internal reference voltage
parameters.hint: On-chip reference output voltage, V.

parameters.name: Internal reference drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of the internal reference, ppm/degC.

parameters.name: Internal reference accuracy
parameters.hint: Initial accuracy of the internal reference, % of nominal.

parameters.name: Reference input current
parameters.hint: Average current drawn from an external reference, A. Scales with sample rate - array over F_S.

parameters.name: Reference input voltage range
parameters.hint: Allowable voltage range at the REFIN pin, V.

parameters.name: Reference turn-on time
parameters.hint: Internal reference power-up / settling time, s.

parameters.name: Common-mode rejection ratio
parameters.hint: CMRR, dB. Array over F_IN (frequency of the common-mode disturbance).

parameters.name: Power-supply rejection ratio
parameters.hint: PSRR, dB. Array over V_SUPPLY (which rail is being rejected).

parameters.name: Normal-mode rejection
parameters.hint: Normal-mode (line-frequency) rejection of the digital filter, dB. Array over F (notch frequency, 50/60 Hz).

parameters.name: Conversion time
parameters.hint: Time from convert-start to result ready, s.

parameters.name: Acquisition time
parameters.hint: Sample/acquisition (track) time, s.

parameters.name: Aperture delay
parameters.hint: Delay from the sampling clock edge to the actual sample instant, s.

parameters.name: Aperture jitter
parameters.hint: RMS sampling-instant uncertainty, s - limits SNR at high F_IN on rf_sampling parts.

parameters.name: Settling time
parameters.hint: Filter/channel settling or startup time after a configuration change, s.

parameters.name: Latency
parameters.hint: Output latency (pipelined/delta-sigma). Convert cycles to seconds via the clock/fS; keep the cycle count (e.g. '12 clock cycles') in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Serial clock frequency
parameters.hint: Maximum serial interface clock (SPI SCLK / I2C SCL), Hz.

parameters.name: Passband
parameters.hint: Digital filter passband edge, Hz (audio). Array over MODE (filter/OSR mode). Often stated as a fraction of ODR - keep that in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Passband ripple
parameters.hint: Peak-to-peak digital filter passband ripple, dB.

parameters.name: Stopband
parameters.hint: Digital filter stopband edge, Hz. Array over MODE.

parameters.name: Stopband attenuation
parameters.hint: Digital filter stopband attenuation, dB.

parameters.name: Group delay
parameters.hint: Digital filter group delay, s. Array over MODE. Often stated in samples - convert via ODR and keep the sample count in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: High-pass filter corner
parameters.hint: DC-blocking high-pass filter corner frequency, Hz (audio).

parameters.name: Supply voltage
parameters.hint: Rail supply voltage, V. A part has several rails (analog AVDD, digital DVDD) - array over V_SUPPLY, one measurement per rail. IO rail is io_supply_voltage.

parameters.name: IO supply voltage
parameters.hint: Digital-interface / IO rail voltage, V (OVDD / VDRIVE).

parameters.name: Supply current
parameters.hint: Operating supply current, A. Array over MODE (speed/power mode); split per rail via a rail condition in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Power dissipation
parameters.hint: Total operating power, W. Array over MODE.

parameters.name: Standby current
parameters.hint: Standby (retention, oscillator running) supply current, A.

parameters.name: Power-down current
parameters.hint: Full power-down / shutdown / sleep current, A.

parameters.name: Power-down dissipation
parameters.hint: Power-down mode power dissipation, W.

parameters.name: Operating temperature range
parameters.hint: Ambient operating temperature range, degC (min/max).

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction-to-ambient
parameters.hint: Junction-to-ambient thermal resistance, degC/W.

parameters.name: ESD, human-body model
parameters.hint: Human-body-model ESD withstand voltage, V.

parameters.name: ESD, charged-device model
parameters.hint: Charged-device-model ESD withstand voltage, V.

parameters.name: PGA gain
parameters.hint: The enumerated PGA gain set the part offers; capture the set as min/max or one measurement per gain, with the list in conditionsVerbatim. Dimensionless V/V. Distinct from the GAIN condition axis (which selects a gain on other parameters).

parameters.name: Oversampling ratio
parameters.hint: Dimensionless oversampling count (V/V); the configurable OSR set. Capture the set as min/max or one measurement per setting, with the list in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Input clock frequency
parameters.hint: The conversion / sampling clock input, Hz. Distinct from serial_clock_frequency (the digital-interface SCLK).

parameters.name: Digital input high voltage
parameters.hint: Minimum logic-high input threshold on a digital control pin, V.

parameters.name: Digital input low voltage
parameters.hint: Maximum logic-low input threshold on a digital control pin, V.

parameters.name: Digital output high voltage
parameters.hint: Logic-high output voltage on a digital pin at the specified load, V.

parameters.name: Digital output low voltage
parameters.hint: Logic-low output voltage on a digital pin at the specified load, V.

parameters.name: Digital input leakage current
parameters.hint: Leakage current into a digital input pin, A.

parameters.name: Storage temperature range
parameters.hint: Storage temperature range, degC (min/max), typically an absolute_max.

parameters.name: Junction temperature
parameters.hint: Maximum operating / absolute-max junction temperature, degC.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction-to-case
parameters.hint: Junction-to-case thermal resistance, degC/W.
